title.en: Help Jojo Settle Down and Draw

description.en: Jojo is full of energy during drawing time and his noise makes it hard for Rhodey to focus. The scene is about helping Jojo shift from active play into a calmer classroom activity.
description.id: Jojo sangat berenergi saat waktunya menggambar dan suaranya membuat Rhodey sulit fokus. Adegan ini tentang membantu Jojo berpindah dari bermain aktif ke aktivitas kelas yang lebih tenang.

completionSummary.en: Jojo's energy needed somewhere to go before an instruction could reach him. Getting his attention gently made the request possible.
completionSummary.id: Energi Jojo perlu disalurkan sebelum instruksi bisa diterimanya. Menarik perhatiannya dengan lembut membuat permintaan tersebut dapat dipahami.

completionTip.en: Get a distracted child's attention first, with a clap or their name, before asking for anything. Then the instruction has a chance to land.
completionTip.id: Tarik perhatian anak yang terdistraksi terlebih dahulu, dengan tepukan tangan atau memanggil namanya, sebelum meminta sesuatu. Dengan begitu, instruksi lebih mungkin diterima.

hints.en: Children often need attention before they can process an instruction.
hints.id: Anak sering perlu diarahkan perhatiannya sebelum bisa memproses instruksi.

placementLimitMessage.en: Jojo and Rhodey are tired. You took too long.
placementLimitMessage.id: Jojo dan Rhodey kelelahan. Kamu terlalu lama.

caregiverLine.en: Jojo, let's use a quieter voice.
caregiverLine.id: Jojo, yuk gunakan suara yang lebih pelan.

caregiverLine.en: Jojo, you need to stop being noisy.
Jojo, look this way for a moment.
Would you like to draw with this crayon?
